## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues and note any compatibility or report-schema changes.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. Explain checks that were not run and why. For UI changes, include screenshots; for SDK changes, include regenerated fixture and documentation review.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change preserves exact arithmetic, conservative refusals and local processing, or explicitly explains an intentional contract change.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No private telemetry, credentials or unrelated generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Dependency or SDK changes include compatibility verification and any required version references.
